title: Jesus... I Heard My Father's Voice Come Out Of My Mouth
topic: fear of becoming like a parent

bible.text: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, “Abba, Father.”

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I shouted at my brother tonight. And it was not my voice. It was my father's.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: The same cold tone he used on me when I was nine.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: And then you saw his face change the way yours used to.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: He went quiet and small. I promised I would never make anyone feel like that.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You did not inherit him. You learned him. What is learned in a house can be unlearned in one.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It feels like it is in my blood, waiting for a night I am tired enough.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your father never stood in a doorway afraid of what he had become. You are standing there now.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Is being sorry enough to break something that old?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: No. Going back into the room is. Tell him it was not his fault. Children believe the shouting is about them.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You were not adopted into fear. You were adopted into a family where you can begin again, tonight, before he falls asleep.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Is there a voice you are trying not to repeat? 🙏 Go back into the room tonight.
